Khaki Field

Field · 38–44mm · 10 bar (100m)/145 psi (328ft) · automatic · 2007–2026

The Hamilton Khaki Field Auto is a versatile and robust field watch that translates the brand's extensive military heritage into a modern, everyday timepiece. It is defined by its classic military-style dial with high legibility, featuring both 12 and 24-hour scales, and a durable case suitable for outdoor adventures.

The story

The Khaki Field line originates from Hamilton's history as a key supplier to the U.S. military, beginning in WWI and ramping up significantly during WWII, when it ceased all civilian production to focus on the war effort. After decades of producing watches to military specifications, Hamilton began marketing the Khaki line to civilians in the post-Vietnam era, leveraging the rugged, functional design. The automatic models became a cornerstone of the collection, initially using reliable Swiss ETA movements before transitioning to Hamilton's proprietary H-series calibers. This evolution marked a significant technical upgrade, most notably by introducing an extended 80-hour power reserve, solidifying the Khaki Field Auto's reputation for value and performance.
